neighbours.label: the token ' Davies' (the surname), in any context
fire: The lecture was given by Dr. Davies on Thursday evening.
Our neighbour Mrs. Davies keeps bees in her garden.
The winning try was scored by Gareth Davies in the last minute.
As Davies argued in his second book, the evidence is thin.
The committee thanked Councillor Davies for her long service.
A portrait of Sir Walter Davies hangs in the hall.
The shop on the corner belongs to the Davies family.
In the footnotes, the author cites Davies 2004 several times.
